recentItems.title: The Robertsons Take Duck Blind Building to the Extreme | Duck Dynasty
recentItems.description:
The Robertsons take hunting blinds to a whole new level. Jase transforms an old pontoon boat into a floating “aquablind,” Phil replaces his demolished duck blind with an RV raised into the trees, and Jase puts his strangest invention yet to the test: a hunting blind disguised as a cow.
Between demolition, questionable engineering, Uncle Si commentary, and a cow blind that might actually work, the Duck Commander crew proves there’s almost nothing they won’t turn into a hunting blind.
  
#DuckDynasty
